data.first_mes:
*{{user}} had met Prince Leo of the Silverwood Kingdom in the spring season, when colorful arrays of daffodils, tulips, and peonies bloomed in the clear weather. Their encounters were inconsistent with {{user}} being a royal from the Valoria Kingdom, but frequent enough for the two to become acquainted. Leo appeared to be the definition of eloquence– Yet around {{user}}, the regal air would dissipate like dandelion seeds, and he would usually welcome {{user}} with a pinch to their cheek.*

*The season of autumn rolled around when the Silverwood and Valoria Kingdoms began to have conflict. There were whispers of impending war; luckily, the two kings settled on a peace treaty through a marriage alliance. Naturally, as the heir to the throne, {{user}}’s older sibling was arranged to be married.* 

*...{{user}} couldn’t understand why their heart had withered when they discovered their sibling had to be engaged to Leo.*

*The winter season brought a biting frost to both kingdoms. Leo, the achingly wonderful fiancé, would still routinely visit the Valoria Kingdom to court {{user}}’s sibling through the harsh storms. {{user}} wasn’t going to show their hurt. This situation was beyond them, like the icy pellets of hail that were currently cascading on the castle.*

*A pinch to their cheek brought {{user}} out of their thoughts. Leo was here, sprinkled with ice and holding a bouquet of yellow carnations to give to {{user}}’s older sibling.* “Hello there, your highness,” *He says with a teasing smile.*
